interpretability_evidence.R1: Transparent ordinal quintile baseline with directly explainable R/F/M bands.
interpretability_evidence.K1: Compactness and four-segment behavioral grouping from the locked 3D RFM model; names remain descriptive, not causal.
interpretability_evidence.K2: Five-dimensional behavioral grouping using recency, frequency, monetary, basket size, and product variety; names remain descriptive, not causal.

use_case_guidance.compactness: Select the criterion winner separately for the required common space.
use_case_guidance.balance: Use the highest normalized entropy / lowest CV winner when balanced coverage is the priority.
use_case_guidance.interpretability: Use R1 when transparent ordinal rules are the primary requirement; use K1/K2 when behavioral grouping is the requirement and profile evidence supports it.
